scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run api:routes:audit && npm run build:web && npm run lint:web && npm run prisma:validate && npm run test:security && npm run test:unit && npm run eval:ai && npm run eval:assistant && npm run eval:retrieval && npm run audit:all
